title: Technical Specialist-GIT
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an Azure Cloud Operations Engineer (L2) to join the Cloud Infrastructure Operations team at HCLTech. You will operate, monitor and support Azure workloads across compute, networking, storage, identity, integration, container and data services, resolve escalated incidents and service requests, and coordinate with cloud, security and application teams to keep the environment stable, secure and compliant

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Perform L2 operational support for Azure services; resolve incidents, service requests and changes within SLAs.
* Monitor environments using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Activity Log, alerts and Service Health; drive root-cause analysis.
* Administer Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, PIM and managed identities under approved access processes.
* Coordinate Key Vault access and certificate/secret operations without taking ownership of application secrets.
* Manage backup, Site Recovery and disaster-recovery readiness, including restore and DR drill support.
* Support AKS deployments and troubleshoot AKS infrastructure issues.
* Create and support Azure SQL and related infrastructure.
* Support networking components including VPN/ExpressRoute coordination, Private Link and Private DNS.
* Apply governance through Azure Policy, management groups, subscriptions and tagging standards.
* Follow change management and incident management processes; escalate to L3 / vendor support with clear analysis.

Maintain runbooks, SOPs and knowledge articles; support audits and close observations on time

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Hands-on operational experience with the Azure services listed in the technology scope.
* Knowledge of change management and incident management processes (ITIL).
* Strong understanding of Azure networking and ability to troubleshoot connectivity issues.
* Working knowledge of Windows and/or Linux server administration on Azure VMs.
* Good troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and escalation skills.

Clear documentation and communication skills

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Azure Cloud Services,Azure Database for MySQL,Azure Monitor

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Azure certifications such as AZ-900, AZ-104 (Administrator) or AZ-500.
* Scripting in PowerShell, Azure CLI or Python.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (ARM / Bicep / Terraform).
* Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tools.
* Understanding of cloud security, compliance and FinOps basics.

**Educational Qualification**
-----------------------------

B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc. (CS/IT) or equivalent.

**Behavioral Competencies**
---------------------------

* Ownership and accountability for incidents and SLAs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
* Collaborative approach with cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to work in shifts or on-call rotation, if required.

title: SME - Kubernetes, Terraform
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced Linux / UNIX Engineer (L3) to own the stability, security and performance of our enterprise server environment. As the final technical escalation point, you will resolve complex incidents, perform root cause analysis, design and implement infrastructure improvements, and guide L1/L2 teams. The role requires deep hands-on expertise across Linux and UNIX platforms, strong automation skills, and the ability to work closely with application, database, network, storage and cloud teams to deliver reliable services in line with agreed SLAs.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Incident, Problem and Escalation Management • Act as the final escalation point (L3) for complex Linux / UNIX incidents escalated from L1/L2 teams. • Troubleshoot and resolve critical (P1/P2) issues related to OS, kernel, boot, file systems, performance, memory, networking and storage. • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major incidents and drive permanent fixes through problem management. • Analyze system logs, core dumps and crash dumps (kdump, sosreport, explorer) to identify underlying issues. • Coordinate with OEM vendors (Red Hat, SUSE, Oracle, IBM, HPE, Dell) for case escalation and resolution. • Participate in on-call rotation and lead bridge calls during major incidents. Server Build, Engineering and Administration • Design, build, configure and decommission physical and virtual Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky, Oracle Linux, SUSE, Ubuntu) and UNIX (Solaris, AIX, HP-UX) servers. • Define and maintain standard OS build templates, golden images and hardening baselines. • Manage storage and file systems including LVM, ext4, XFS, ZFS, NFS, CIFS/Samba, multipathing and SAN/NAS integration. • Configure and support high-availability clusters (Pacemaker/Corosync, Veritas Cluster Server, Red Hat HA, PowerHA/HACMP). • Manage virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere, KVM, Solaris Zones/LDOMs and IBM LPARs. • Administer core services including DNS, DHCP, NTP/Chrony, SSH, Postfix/Sendmail, Apache/Nginx and cron. • Patching, Upgrades and Lifecycle Management\\r\\n• Plan and execute OS patching, kernel upgrades and major version migrations with minimal downtime. • Manage patch repositories and lifecycle tools such as Red Hat Satellite, SUSE Manager, Spacewalk or IBM NIM. • Track end-of-life (EOL) platforms and drive remediation, refresh and migration plans. • Perform firmware and hardware upgrades in coordination with data center and vendor teams. Security, Compliance and Access Management • Implement and maintain OS hardening in line with CIS benchmarks and organizational security policies. • Remediate vulnerabilities identified through scanning tools (Qualys, Tenable/Nessus, Rapid7) within defined timelines. • Manage user and privileged access, sudo policies, PAM, SELinux/AppArmor, firewalld/iptables and SSH key management. • Integrate Linux / UNIX systems with Active Directory / LDAP using SSSD, Centrify or Winbind. • Support internal and external audits (SOX, ISO 27001, GxP, PCI-DSS) and provide evidence as required. Automation, Monitoring and Performance • Automate routine tasks, builds, patching and compliance checks using Shell, Python, Perl and Ansible. • Develop and maintain configuration management with Ansible, Puppet, Chef or SaltStack. • Configure and tune monitoring and alerting using tools such as Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace or SolarWinds. • Conduct capacity planning and performance tuning for CPU, memory, disk I/O, network and kernel parameters. • Identify repetitive incidents and eliminate them through automation and self-healing solutions. Backup, Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity • Ensure backup and restore processes are configured and tested using tools such as Veritas NetBackup, Commvault, Veeam or IBM Spectrum Protect. • Design, document and execute DR plans and participate in periodic DR drills. • Validate recovery procedures and maintain RTO/RPO compliance for critical systems. Process, Documentation and Leadership • Follow ITIL processes for incident, problem, change and request management using ServiceNow, BMC Remedy or similar ITSM tools. • Prepare and present change requests, implementation plans and rollback plans to the Change Advisory Board (CAB). • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge base articles, architecture diagrams and RCA reports. • Mentor and upskill L1/L2 engineers through knowledge transfer sessions and technical reviews. • Ensure SLA, KPI and operational metrics are met and contribute to continuous service improvement initiatives.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Operating Systems Expert-level RHEL / CentOS / Rocky / Oracle Linux, SUSE, Ubuntu; working knowledge of Solaris, AIX or HP-UX • Troubleshooting Boot and GRUB issues, kernel panics, hung systems, performance bottlenecks, crash dump analysis, strace, tcpdump, sar, vmstat, iostat • Storage and File Systems LVM, XFS, ext4, ZFS, NFS, Samba, iSCSI, SAN multipathing, RAID • Clustering and HA Pacemaker/Corosync, Veritas Cluster Server, Red Hat HA, PowerHA • Virtualization VMware vSphere, KVM, Solaris Zones / LDOMs, IBM LPAR • Scripting and Automation Bash / Shell, Python, Perl; Ansible (required), Puppet / Chef (preferred) • Networking TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, bonding / teaming, VLANs, firewalls, load balancers • Security CIS hardening, SELinux, sudo, PAM, SSH, vulnerability remediation, AD / LDAP integration • Tools Red Hat Satellite, ServiceNow, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, Splunk, Prometheus / Grafana), backup tools

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service,AWS CloudFormation,PaaS - AWS,Terraform,Linux,Kubernetes

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Public cloud experience with AWS (EC2, EBS, IAM), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform. • Containers and orchestration: Docker, Podman, Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift. • Infrastructure as Code with Terraform; CI/CD tools such as Git, Jenkins or GitLab. • Support for enterprise applications and databases on Linux / UNIX (Oracle, SAP, WebLogic, Tomcat, JBoss). • Experience in regulated industries such as pharma, healthcare or financial services. Qualifications and Certifications • Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent practical experience. • 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Linux / UNIX administration, with at least 3–4 years in an L3 or engineering role. • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) – strongly preferred. • Additional certifications are an advantage: SUSE Certified Engineer, Oracle Solaris, IBM AIX, LPIC-2/3, ITIL v4 Foundation, AWS / Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA). Soft Skills and Competencies • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to troubleshooting. • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders and leadership. • Ability to stay calm and lead effectively during high-pressure, business-critical incidents. • Ownership mindset with a focus on service quality, documentation and continuous improvement. • Team player who mentors others and collaborates well across global, cross-functional teams.

title: Track Manager - Splunk, Bash (Scripting Language), Python
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced Splunk L3 Administrator responsible for administration, engineering, troubleshooting, optimization, and operational support of enterprise Splunk environments. The candidate should have strong expertise across Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Universal/Heavy Forwarders, Search Head Clustering, Indexer Clustering, data onboarding, SPL, security, performance tuning, and platform upgrades. The role will act as an L3 escalation point, drive complex problem resolution, support major incidents, implement automation, and ensure the Splunk platform remains highly available, secure, scalable, and optimized.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Key Responsibilities Splunk Administration & Engineering Administer and support large-scale Splunk Enterprise environments across production and non-production. Manage Search Heads, Indexers, Cluster Managers, Deployment Servers, License Managers, Heavy Forwarders, and Universal Forwarders. Configure and maintain Indexer Clustering and Search Head Clustering. Perform installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, migrations, and platform lifecycle activities. Manage Splunk configuration files including inputs.conf, outputs.conf, props.conf, transforms.conf, server.conf, indexes.conf, and limits.conf. Perform Splunk application and configuration deployment through appropriate deployment mechanisms. Data Onboarding & Integration Onboard data from Windows, Linux, network devices, security platforms, applications, databases, cloud platforms, APIs, and syslog sources. Configure source types, field extraction, event parsing, timestamp recognition, line breaking, filtering, and routing. Troubleshoot ingestion issues across Universal Forwarders, Heavy Forwarders, syslog infrastructure, and Splunk Indexers. Monitor ingestion volume and licensing consumption and optimize data onboarding where required. SPL, Dashboards & Monitoring Develop and troubleshoot complex Splunk Search Processing Language (SPL) queries. Create and optimize dashboards, reports, alerts, scheduled searches, and knowledge objects. Optimize inefficient searches to improve platform performance. Support operational and application teams in establishing monitoring and alerting use cases. Performance & Capacity Management Monitor overall Splunk platform health, indexing rates, search performance, resource utilization, and ingestion latency. Perform capacity planning for compute, storage, daily ingestion, retention, and license utilization. Troubleshoot blocked queues, skipped searches, indexing delays, high CPU/memory utilization, and search performance issues. Use Splunk Monitoring Console and internal logs for proactive health monitoring and troubleshooting. Security & Access Management Implement and maintain RBAC, user roles, authentication, and authorization. Support integration with enterprise identity solutions such as LDAP/SAML/SSO. Manage certificates and TLS configuration for secure Splunk communication. Ensure adherence to enterprise security, compliance, hardening, and audit requirements. Incident, Problem & Change Management Act as L3 SME and escalation point for complex Splunk platform issues. Participate in P1/P2 major incident troubleshooting and recovery. Perform root cause analysis and develop corrective/preventive actions. Execute production changes following ITIL-based change management processes. Work with application, infrastructure, network, security, database, and cloud teams for end-to-end troubleshooting. Automation Develop automation using Shell scripting, Python, REST APIs, Git, and Ansible where applicable. Automate repetitive Splunk administration, health checks, configuration deployment, and operational activities. Identify opportunities for proactive monitoring and self-healing.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Required Technical Skills Mandatory: Splunk Enterprise Administration Search Head Clustering Indexer Clustering Universal and Heavy Forwarders Splunk Deployment Server Data onboarding and ingestion troubleshooting Advanced SPL props.conf and transforms.conf Index and retention management Splunk Monitoring Console RBAC / LDAP / SAML Linux administration Shell scripting REST APIs Performance tuning and capacity management Production incident troubleshooting Good to Have: Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) Splunk IT Service Intelligence (ITSI) Splunk Observability AWS / Azure integrations Kubernetes/container monitoring Ansible Python Git / CI/CD Syslog platforms ServiceNow integration

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Bash,Python,Splunk

---------------

We are looking for an experienced L3 Database Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft SQL Server to own the stability, performance, security, and recoverability of our production database estate. As the final technical escalation point above the L1 and L2 teams, you will resolve complex and business-critical SQL Server issues, lead root cause analysis, design high availability and disaster recovery solutions, and drive automation and continuous improvement. You will also mentor junior DBAs and work closely with application, infrastructure, security, and cloud teams to keep databases reliable, scalable, and compliant.

Installation, Upgrades, Patching, and Migrations • Build and configure SQL Server instances (2016, 2017, 2019, 2022) to approved standards and hardening baselines. • Plan and execute version upgrades, Cumulative Update (CU) and security patching with minimal downtime. • Lead database migrations, including on-premises to Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs, or AWS RDS for SQL Server. • Review and approve database changes and deployment scripts through the change management (CAB) process, with implementation and rollback plans. 5. Automation, Monitoring, and Continuous Improvement • Automate health checks, backups, patching, provisioning, and reporting using PowerShell (dbatools), T-SQL, and SQL Server Agent jobs. • Configure and fine-tune monitoring and alerting (for example, SolarWinds DPA, Redgate SQL Monitor, SCOM, or Azure Monitor). • Support database CI/CD using tools such as Azure DevOps, Git, SSDT/DACPAC, or Flyway. • Identify improvement opportunities that reduce incident volume, manual effort, and licensing or infrastructure costs. 7. Documentation, Mentoring, and Stakeholder Communication • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, build documents, and knowledge base articles. • Mentor L1 and L2 DBAs, review their work, and run knowledge transfer sessions. • Share RCA reports, health check findings, and improvement proposals with application owners and leadership in clear,

# Job Description: Sales & Marketing Executive

\*Industry:\* Physiotherapy, Rehabilitation & Healthcare

\*Department:\* Sales, Marketing & Business Development

\*Job Type:\* Full-time

\*Reporting To:\* Business Development Manager / Management

## 1. Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive, result-oriented Sales & Marketing Executive to drive business growth for our physiotherapy services, clinics, and associated healthcare entities. The candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, developing relationships with physiotherapists and healthcare professionals, acquiring corporate and institutional clients, managing lead generation activities, and handling Public Relations Officer (PRO) responsibilities.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication, networking, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, along with the ability to convert leads into business opportunities and achieve revenue targets.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Business Development

- Identify and develop new business opportunities for physiotherapy and rehabilitation services.

- Build relationships with hospitals, clinics, doctors, physiotherapists, orthopaedic specialists, sports academies, gyms, corporates, and healthcare institutions.

- Develop referral networks with healthcare professionals and relevant business partners.

- Explore opportunities for corporate wellness programs, home physiotherapy services, rehabilitation partnerships, and institutional tie-ups.

- Conduct field visits, client meetings, presentations, and business negotiations.

- Prepare proposals, quotations, partnership plans, and commercial offers.

- Achieve monthly and quarterly business development and revenue targets.

- Research competitors, market trends, and new business opportunities.

B. Lead Generation & Sales

- Generate qualified leads through field visits, cold calling, email campaigns, WhatsApp outreach, networking, and digital marketing initiatives.

- Identify potential patients, corporate clients, referral partners, clinics, and healthcare institutions.

- Maintain and regularly update the sales pipeline and lead database.

- Follow up with prospects and convert leads into appointments, partnerships, and paying clients.

- Schedule meetings and demonstrations with prospective clients and partners.

- Track lead conversion rates, sales performance, and customer acquisition.

- Coordinate with the operations and clinical teams to ensure a smooth onboarding experience.

- Maintain accurate records of all sales activities in the CRM or designated reporting system.

C. Marketing & Brand Promotion

- Promote the organisation’s physiotherapy, rehabilitation, wellness, and related healthcare services.

- Support the planning and execution of online and offline marketing campaigns.

- Coordinate with the digital marketing team for social media promotions, local marketing, and lead-generation campaigns.

- Organise health camps, physiotherapy awareness sessions, workshops, and community outreach programs.

- Develop marketing materials, presentations, brochures, and promotional content in coordination with the relevant teams.

- Build brand visibility among doctors, physiotherapists, hospitals, corporates, and local communities.

- Monitor campaign performance and suggest improvements to increase enquiries and conversions.

D. PRO – Public Relations Officer Responsibilities

- Act as a key point of contact for external stakeholders, healthcare partners, clients, and institutional representatives.

- Build and maintain professional relationships with doctors, hospital administrators, physiotherapists, corporate HR teams, and other stakeholders.

- Represent the organisation at meetings, healthcare events, networking sessions, exhibitions, and community programs.

- Coordinate public relations activities, partnership meetings, and promotional events.

- Manage professional communication with clients and business partners.

- Collect feedback, address routine client concerns, and coordinate with internal teams for resolution.

- Maintain the organisation’s professional image and ensure consistent communication of its services and values.

- Support the development of referral relationships and long-term strategic partnerships.

E. Relationship Management & Account Growth

- Maintain regular contact with existing clients, referral partners, and institutional accounts.

- Identify opportunities to expand services within existing accounts.

- Ensure timely follow-ups, client satisfaction, and partner engagement.

- Coordinate with physiotherapists and clinical teams to understand service requirements and client expectations.

- Support client retention, repeat business, and long-term partnerships.

F. Reporting & Performance Tracking

- Submit daily activity reports covering calls, visits, meetings, and leads generated.

- Prepare weekly sales pipeline updates and monthly performance reports.

- Track revenue generated, lead conversion, new partnerships, and campaign outcomes.

- Maintain a database of prospects, clients, doctors, physiotherapists, and referral partners.

- Provide regular market feedback and recommendations to management.

3. Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Healthcare Management, or a related field.

- 1–3 years of experience in sales, marketing, business development, healthcare, or service-based industries preferred.

- Experience in physiotherapy, rehabilitation, hospitals, clinics, diagnostics, or wellness services will be an advantage.

- Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to generate leads, build professional networks, and close business opportunities.

- Good knowledge of MS Office, Google Workspace, CRM tools, and digital communication platforms.

- Willingness to travel for field visits, client meetings, and business development activities.

- Target-oriented, self-motivated, organised, and capable of working independently.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured against mutually agreed targets, including:

- Number of qualified leads generated per month.

- Number of client meetings and field visits completed.

- Number of new business accounts and institutional tie-ups secured.

- Lead-to-customer conversion rate.

- Revenue generated from new and existing accounts.

- Number of active referral partners and professional relationships developed.

- Number of corporate wellness programs, health camps, and promotional activities conducted.

- Follow-up efficiency and client retention.

- Timeliness and accuracy of sales and activity reports.

5. Expected Outcomes

- Consistent growth in qualified leads and business enquiries.

- Increased revenue and market presence for physiotherapy and rehabilitation services.

- Strong referral networks with doctors, physiotherapists, hospitals, and healthcare partners.

- Successful acquisition of corporate and institutional clients.

- Improved brand awareness, client engagement, and business relationships.

- A well-maintained and measurable sales pipeline.

6. Additional Requirements

- Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality when handling patient or client information.

- Follow ethical healthcare marketing practices and applicable organisational policies.

- Do not make unsupported clinical claims or provide medical advice outside the candidate’s professional qualifications.

- Coordinate closely with clinical, operations, and marketing teams to ensure service quality and customer satisfaction.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role -**

We are seeking a motivated and detail‑oriented Database Administrator (DBA) with 4 - 10 years of proven hands‑on experience in Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL). You will support the design, implementation, operations, and continuous improvement of mission‑critical SQL Server databases. The role requires solid skills in performance tuning, high availability, backup & recovery, and security hardening, working within a collaborative production environment and contributing to team standards and best practices. As the team expands its use of OceanBase and PostgreSQL, the ideal candidate will bring a strong willingness to learn these platforms and support migrations from SQL Server.

**The Work -**

**Database Implementation and Support**

* Install, configure, and manage the lifecycle of SQL Server instances (standalone, clustered, and Always On) across environments.
* Contribute to database architecture decisions (storage layout, file/filegroup design, instance sizing) across dev/QA/prod.
* Design and deploy schema objects (tables, views, stored procedures, functions), following standards and participating in code reviews.
* Implement and maintain configuration baselines (e.g., max server memory, MAXDOP, cost threshold for parallelism, TempDB layout).

**High Availability & Disaster Recovery**

* Implement and operate SQL Server HA/DR solutions including Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, and Log Shipping.
* Maintain DR runbooks and support RTO/RPO targets; participate in planned failover and disaster recovery testing.
* Monitor AG synchronization health, cluster resources, and quorum configuration; troubleshoot failover events.
* Regularly test backups and end‑to‑end recovery (database‑level, point‑in‑time, and site failover).

**Monitoring and Alerting**

* Set up proactive alerting for blocking, deadlocks, long‑running queries, failed jobs, AG latency, and disk space.
* Configure and tune monitoring for wait stats, TempDB health, I/O latency, index fragmentation, and blocking chains.
* Analyze metrics, logs, and execution plans to derive actionable insights and support incident response.

**Capacity Planning**

* Track storage, compute, and connection usage, and forecast capacity based on growth patterns and workload characteristics.
* Perform index and data growth analysis, and recommend cost‑efficient scaling approaches.

**Backup and Recovery Operations**

* Implement and automate SQL Server backup strategies (full/differential/transaction log) using native tools or Ola Hallengren maintenance solutions.
* Validate restores regularly through automated restore drills and DBCC CHECKDB integrity checks.
* Document recovery playbooks and ensure compliance with RPO/RTO objectives.

**Performance Tuning**

* Tune SQL Server workloads using execution plans, Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events, and statistics maintenance.
* Optimize indexing strategy, mitigate parameter sniffing, and tune memory/parallelism settings; apply plan forcing when appropriate.
* Define performance baselines; guide developers on query design and access patterns.

**Security and Access Control**

* Implement least‑privilege access, role‑based security, password policies/secrets management, encryption (TDE/Always Encrypted), and auditing for SQL Server.
* Support audit/compliance requirements and periodic access reviews.

**Patching and Updates**

* Plan and execute SQL Server CU/version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
* Evaluate new SQL Server features and recommend adoption where relevant.
* Support database migrations from SQL Server to OceanBase or PostgreSQL, including schema and code conversion, data movement, cutover planning, and post‑migration validation.

**Incident Handling**

* Troubleshoot and perform root‑cause analysis for performance, availability, and data integrity incidents.
* Contribute to post‑incident reviews and implement preventative measures.
